How prompts and skills work
  • A human starts the journeys promote task. Add as a skill… copies npm run skill -- <id> --to <path>, which adds a skill to another codebase, for example the product's.
  • Every component, screen and journey has its own prompt on its page. npm run prompt -- <id> prints the same text, and --hash its source fingerprint, so a pasted copy can be checked. Skills and prompt wording are the designup package's (a change to them belongs in the designup repository): edit the facts in the source, never a prompt.
